ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels (concentrated on the right lobe) to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels (dominant on the left lobe and central regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe: Broad contiguous high-intensity region with localized dark stippling and mottling concentrated near the distal tip and trailing edge. Left lobe: Predominantly uniform low-intensity dark mapping with minor high-intensity pixel clusters near the trailing boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes. Right lobe features a prominent high-amplitude peak approximately 30% inward from the tip. Left lobe displays a more uniform, lower-amplitude jagged boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch extending to sharply pointed, upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters on a light background are visible on the distal tip of the right lobe; similar high-intensity clusters are visible at the extreme tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned diagonal linear disruption (scratch) is visible in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe, oriented roughly 45 degrees toward the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear scar on the left lobe surface; irregular indentation/trauma site on the right lobe trailing edge approximately one-third distance from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a nearly solid dark left lobe and a predominantly white mottled right lobe.
